description: Decides one suggestion Sergio read from an uploaded document (itemId from read_company_document or read entity company_documents), as the setup guide's taps do: approve creates the flow as a draft that is OFF or the recurring task PAUSED (nothing runs or sends until a person turns it on); edit rewrites its sentence; skip drops it. approve with sentence applies that edit first. A repeat returns the same created row.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: decide_company_document_suggestion
title: Approve, edit or skip a document suggestion
